packet.headline_seed: Archbishop praises Pope's anti-war comments during Vatican visit

what: Archbishop praises Pope's anti-war comments during Vatican visit

clean_source_blocks.text: Dame Sarah Mullally, the first female head of the Church of England, had a private discussion with Pope Leo during the trip.
Dame Sarah Mullally, the first woman to lead the Church of England, met Pope Leo at the Apostolic Palace on Monday, and told the pontiff he would receive a "warm welcome" if he were to visit the UK.
Dame Sarah Mullally was officially installed as the 106th Archbishop of Canterbury – and first female to hold the high office in its 1,400-year history.
It comes as Lambeth Palace announced that the archbishop will visit Rome from April 25 to 28, during which time she will meet the Pope at the Vatican.
